body.p: Sarah Mitchell is the New York Times bestselling author of The Last Algorithm, Zero Day, and The Pattern. A former software engineer at Google and Apple, she holds a degree in Computer Science from Carnegie Mellon University and an MFA in Creative Writing from the Iowa Writers' Workshop.
Her fiction has appeared in The New Yorker, Wired, Clarkesworld, and The Best American Science Fiction and Fantasy. She has been a finalist for the Hugo, Nebula, and Arthur C. Clarke awards.
Sarah lives in San Francisco with her partner, David, and an unreasonable number of mechanical keyboards. She is currently at work on the second novel in the Meridian Systems trilogy.
Visit her online at sarahmitchellbooks.com or follow her on social media @sarahmwrites.
